An 84 year old Pine Forest resident was killed at his residence on Hulett Street by a fallen tree limb. As the man arrived home at his residence and exited a vehicle, a tree limb as large as a car was blown out of a 60 foot tall pine tree and crushed both him and the vehicle.
A trained spotter reported an oak tree was split in half and knocked over by high winds.

Several trees were snapped and at least 5-6 homes received minor roof damage in Orangefield on 3rd and 4th Street. One large garage was destroyed.
Multiple reports were received from around the city of Orange of trees and tree limbs down. Reports were relayed by the Orange Police Department.
